text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —Alriiiight! It's finally time!! Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! You can tell right away it's an 
established, historic inn! It looks 
amazing~!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! It's old, but it's totally 
spotless! Proof that the innkeepers really 
value discipline!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Right now, I'm staying at a hot spring 
inn with Bamboo Memory. As for how this 
suddenly came about—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer!! It's finally time to use 
"that"!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Um, the Hot Springs Trip Voucher!! Without 
a doubt, now is the time to use it!!
choice_data_list:
True, I guess that does wrap things up for 
now.

True, I guess we've reached a good 
stopping point, haven't we?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You bet! Time to take a breather and treat 
myself to a—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: "...Or so you thought!! I'm not!!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Exactly because things have settled 
down, everyone tends to slack off around 
this time! But my fight is far from over!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
A send-off party to blow away any 
lingering complacency!! With that in mind, 
let's gooo!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we ended up going on a hot springs 
trip. Since we arrived early, I was just 
about to suggest we go sightseeing around 
the area, when—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right, that's right!! I've 
gotta go greet everyone at the inn!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
“—Thanks for having me today! ...Ooh, it's 
so shiny in here, too! I'm in awe!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...She seems to be in even higher spirits 
than usual, too. Without a word, she'll 
probably drag me all over the place."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After sightseeing in various spots, 
returning to the inn, and relaxing in the 
hot springs—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Aahh, that was such a nice bath! And 
soaking in that hot water brought back 
memories of all those fiery, fierce 
battles...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, weren't you feeling the exact 
same way as me?! You totally were, right?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —However, the truth of the matter was...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—That late surge at the end! The moment 
her engine fired on all cylinders! That 
race was purely amazing! And after that—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...She was shouting her overflowing 
feelings at the top of her lungs for all 
around to hear, so I couldn't help but 
remember, but...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
We're gonna make even more passionate 
memories like that...! Whoaa, our youth is 
limitless, yo~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm getting a little worried. Getting 
this hyped up, will she even be able to 
sleep properly tonight...?"
choice_data_list: ...Why don't we turn on the TV for a bit?
...Want to turn on the TV for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sounds great! Watching TV shows while 
traveling feels kinda special and 
exciting!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, isn't that a school drama?! I 
wonder what kind of story it is!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, whoa...! So the hot-blooded cheer 
squad leader protagonist clashes with the 
students and builds bonds of friendship, 
huh!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa~, this is totally my jam! I didn't 
know they had something like this going on 
right now!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, if I'm the protagonist... then this 
quiet, overpowered-looking character's 
gotta be Oguri-senpai, right!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
The serious and stoic karate club member 
is Yaeno! The hardworking junior who steps 
up when it counts ...is Chiyono O, for 
sure!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
This quiet but strong-willed library 
committee member is Ardan-senpai... and 
the rest are~... Hmm~...?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"...I just realized you're the only one 
who isn't here, Trainer~."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
If there's a passionate teacher role in 
here, would that be Trainer...? No, that 
feels a bit off, I think.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
A strict master, maybe...? But there's way 
too much kindness in the mix for that.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
A dependable partner...? No way, but 
Trainer, you're also overflowing with that 
whole broad-minded, embracing vibe!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh...? What you mean to me, Trainer? 
That's kinda hard to answer, y'know? Hold 
on a sec...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(—Trainer's always guiding me, always 
thinking about me, so reliable, and...)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(—He can be a little sloppy sometimes, but 
he always fixes it right away.)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(—Besides, because Trainer was there, I 
was able to meet the greatest rivals and 
race against them...!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(As long as you're by my side, I can 
passionately take on any dream!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: (...Such a person—!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah! I get it now!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I thought a lot about it! But it's just 
impossible to sum up what Trainer means to 
me in a single word!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
So, I'll tell you the one thing that's 
certain right now! *inhale*...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
From now on!! And in the past!! Me without 
you, Trainer, is totally impossible!!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
So!! I look forward!! To working with 
you!!!! For a long, long time to come!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—Her passionate words resonated deep 
within my heart... and went right past it 
to echo throughout the entire inn."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond with Bamboo Memory...
